column1: # The red run: this tree's assertions against the engine the base ref holds,
# written whole by tests/red, which tests/run --record-assertions calls.
#   base  <ref>  <sha>  <engine version there>
#   run   <failed>  <passed>  <skipped>        lines counted, not the summary
#   <assertion name>  <times it failed>        failed names only
#   an assertion the manifest lists that the base run never reached counts as failed, by its shortfall
# A base of - means no complete red run was made: none was possible, the
# suite stopped before reached or reached no assertion, or tests/red itself
# was stopped; its stdout said which unless it was the one stopped.
# Reproduce with: tests/red <ref>
base
run

A25 (slice 2 review, not blind): a refusal whose one blocker is base provider (no answer from the provider) is hourly: its row says (tried again an hour after this row), a tick inside the hour does not run felix merge again, and once the row is an hour old one does
A5 (B9): with a blob main's engine tracks missing, felix merge refuses with exit 1, saying it could not copy main's engine, runs nothing, calls no gh, and a real run records one refused judge row
a checkout with no github remote is refused with exactly one refused row

ts3b: S5.3 (no answer, in a merge): call Q exits 1, and an honest candidate is refused with a base line, and nothing is merged

ts3b: S5.4 (the base moves at the last moment): call Q answers M, then M2, and the merge is refused with a moved line after asking Q twice, and nothing is merged

ts3b: S6.3 (an object whose content is not its name): a candidate that deletes MARKER, with the loose file for P's tools/lib.sh rewritten so fx_check is true, is refused with an objects line naming that blob, and nothing is merged
